body:
You have different API available to achieve such behaviour:

- You can use the [connectors](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/connectors.html) to implement your own widget. You will have the full control of what is render without the need to reimplement all the logic of the widgets. But you are still tight to InstantSearch.

- You can also create a full [custom widget](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/guides/custom-widget.html), you will have access to [helper](https://community.algolia.com/algoliasearch-helper-js/) instance. The helper is the internal tool that we used to track the state of the search. Again you are still tight to InstantSearch.

- Last option you can also get the `helper` reference from the InstantSearch instance if you don't want to be tight to it. You can retrieve the helper instance like this:

```js
const search = instantseach(...);

search.start();

search.helper // You can do whatever you want with it
```
